observations.implementation: portico slab and centered facade assembly

observations.feature: four prominent round upper-storey portico columns
strong floor/cornice string courses across front facade
repeated vertical pilaster/bay rhythm on flanking wings
green projecting metal awnings over multiple facade openings
raised central sign/parapet block above the portico
shallow sloping/gabled roof mass visible behind central facade
